QUOTE: In C it is `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`, where `mbedtls_ct_zero` is a `volatile` global set to 0 (`constant_time.c:29`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the C fallback of the same function (`mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque`) XORs with the volatile global `mbedtls_ct_zero`, which holds 0, and it names that global.
